verses.sa:
वेनस्तत्पश्यत्परमं गुहा यद्यत्र विश्वं भवत्येकरूपम् ।
इदं पृश्निरदुहज्जायमानाः स्वर्विदो अभ्यनूषत व्राः ॥
verses.rom:
venastatpashyatparamam guha yadyatra vishvam bhavatyekarupam |
idam prishniraduhajjayamanah svarvido abhyanushata vrah ||

verses.sa:
प्र तद्वोचेदमृतस्य विद्वान् गन्धर्वो धाम परमं गुहा यत्।
त्रीणि पदानि निहिता गुहास्य यस्तानि वेद स पितुष्पितासत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra tadvochedamritasya vidvan gandharvo dhama paramam guha yat|
trini padani nihita guhasya yastani veda sa pitushpitasat ||

verses.sa:
स नः पिता जनिता स उत बन्धुर्धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा ।
यो देवानां नामध एक एव तं संप्रश्नं भुवना यन्ति सर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pita janita sa uta bandhurdhamani veda bhuvanani vishva |
yo devanam namadha eka eva tam samprashnam bhuvana yanti sarva ||

verses.sa:
परि द्यावापृथिवी सद्य आयमुपातिष्ठे प्रथमजामृतस्य ।
वाचमिव वक्तरि भुवनेष्ठा धास्युरेष नन्वेषो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
pari dyavaprithivi sadya ayamupatishthe prathamajamritasya |
vachamiva vaktari bhuvaneshtha dhasyuresha nanvesho agnih ||

verses.sa:
परि विश्वा भुवनान्यायमृतस्य तन्तुं विततं दृशे कम् ।
यत्र देवा अमृतमानशानाः समाने योनावध्यैरयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
pari vishva bhuvananyayamritasya tantum vitatam drishe kam |
yatra deva amritamanashanah samane yonavadhyairayanta ||

prose.en:
2. May the Gandharva, knowing of the immortal, proclaim that highest abode that is in secret; three quarters (padá) of it [are] deposited in secret; whoso knoweth them, he shall be the father's father.

3. He, of us the father, the generator, and he the connection (bándhu), knoweth the abodes, the beings all; who of the gods is the sole nomenclator, of him all beings come to inquire.

4. About heaven-and-earth at once I went; I approached (upa-sthā) the first-born of righteousness (ṛtá), abiding in beings as speech in the speaker; eager (?) is he; is he not Agni (fire)?

5. Around all beings I went, the web (tántu) of righteousness stretched out for beholding, where the gods, having attained immortality (amṛ́ta) bestirred themselves (?īraya-) upon the same place of union (yóni).

verses.sa:
दिव्यो गन्धर्वो भुवनस्य यस्पतिरेक एव नमस्यो विक्ष्वीड्यः ।
तं त्वा यौमि ब्रह्मणा दिव्य देव नमस्ते अस्तु दिवि ते सधस्थम् ॥
verses.rom:
divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatireka eva namasyo vikshvidyah |
tam tva yaumi brahmana divya deva namaste astu divi te sadhastham ||
verses.en: The heavenly Gandharva, who is lord of being (bhúvana), the only one to receive homage, to be praised (īḍ) among the clans (víç)—thee being such I ban (yu) with incantation, O heavenly god; homage be to thee; in the heaven is thy station.

verses.sa:
दिवि स्पृष्टो यजतः सूर्यत्वगवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य ।
मृडात्गन्धर्वो भुवनस्य यस्पतिरेक एव नमस्यः सुशेवाः ॥
verses.rom:
divi sprishto yajatah suryatvagavayata haraso daivyasya |
mridatgandharvo bhuvanasya yaspatireka eva namasyah sushevah ||
verses.en: Touching the sky, worshipful, sun-skinned, deprecator of the seizure (háras) of the gods—gracious shall be the Gandharva, who is lord of being, the only one to receive homage, very propitious.

verses.sa:
अनवद्याभिः समु जग्म आभिरप्सरास्वपि गन्धर्व आसीत्।
समुद्र आसां सदनं म आहुर्यतः सद्य आ च परा च यन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
anavadyabhih samu jagma abhirapsarasvapi gandharva asit|
samudra asam sadanam ma ahuryatah sadya a cha para cha yanti ||
verses.en: He hath united himself (sam-gam) with those irreproachable ones (f.); in (ápi) among the Apsarases was the Gandharva; in the ocean is, they tell me, their seat, whence at once they both come and go.

verses.sa:
अभ्रिये दिद्युन् नक्षत्रिये या विश्वावसुं गन्धर्वं सचध्वे ।
ताभ्यो वो देवीर्नम इत्कृणोमि ॥
verses.rom:
abhriye didyun nakshatriye ya vishvavasum gandharvam sachadhve |
tabhyo vo devirnama itkrinomi ||
verses.en: O cloudy one, gleamer (didyút), starry one—ye that accompany (sac) the Gandharva Viçvāvasu, to you there, O divine ones, homage do I pay.

verses.sa:
याः क्लन्दास्तमिषीचयोऽक्षकामा मनोमुहः ।
ताभ्यो गन्धर्वभ्योऽप्सराभ्योऽकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yah klandastamishichayo'kshakama manomuhah |
tabhyo gandharvabhyo'psarabhyo'karam namah ||
verses.en: They that are noisy, dusky, dice-loving, mind-confusing—to those Apsarases, that have the Gandharvas for spouses, have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
अदो यदवधावत्यवत्कमधि पर्वतात्।
तत्ते कृणोमि भेषजं सुभेषजं यथाससि ॥
verses.rom:
ado yadavadhavatyavatkamadhi parvatat|
tatte krinomi bheshajam subheshajam yathasasi ||
verses.en: What runs down yonder, aiding (?), off the mountain, that do I make for thee a remedy, that thou mayest be a good remedy.

verses.sa:
आदङ्गा कुविदङ्ग शतं या भेषजानि ते ।
तेषामसि त्वमुत्तममनास्रावमरोगणम् ॥
verses.rom:
adanga kuvidanga shatam ya bheshajani te |
teshamasi tvamuttamamanasravamaroganam ||
verses.en: Now then, forsooth! how then, forsooth? what hundred remedies are thine, of them art thou the chief (uttamá), free from flux, free from disease (árogaṇa).

verses.sa:
नीचैः खनन्त्यसुरा अरुस्राणमिदं महत्।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमनीनशत् ॥
verses.rom:
nichaih khanantyasura arusranamidam mahat|
tadasravasya bheshajam tadu rogamaninashat ||
verses.en: The Asuras dig low down this great wound-healer; that is the remedy of flux; that has made the disease (róga) disappear.

verses.sa:
उपजीका उद्भरन्ति समुद्रादधि भेषजम् ।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमशीशमत् ॥
verses.rom:
upajika udbharanti samudradadhi bheshajam |
tadasravasya bheshajam tadu rogamashishamat ||
verses.en: The ants (upajī́kā) bring up the remedy from out the ocean; that is the remedy of flux; that has quieted (çam) the disease.

verses.sa:
अरुस्राणमिदं महत्पृथिव्या अध्युद्भृतम् ।
तदास्रावस्य भेषजं तदु रोगमनीनशत् ॥
verses.rom:
arusranamidam mahatprithivya adhyudbhritam |
tadasravasya bheshajam tadu rogamaninashat ||
verses.en: This is a great wound-healer, brought up from out the earth; that is the remedy of the flux; that has made the disease disappear.

verses.sa:
शं नो भवन्त्वप ओषधयः शिवाः ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रो अप हन्तु रक्षस आराद्विसृष्टा इषवः पतन्तु रक्षसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhavantvapa oshadhayah shivah |
indrasya vajro apa hantu rakshasa aradvisrishta ishavah patantu rakshasam ||
verses.en: Weal be to us the waters, propitious the herbs; let Indra's thunderbolt smite away the demoniacs {rakṣás); far away let the discharged arrows of the demoniacs fly.

verses.sa:
दीर्घायुत्वाय बृहते रणायारिष्यन्तो दक्षमाणाः सदैव ।
मणिं विष्कन्धदूषणं जङ्गिडं बिभृमो वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
dirghayutvaya brihate ranayarishyanto dakshamanah sadaiva |
manim vishkandhadushanam jangidam bibhrimo vayam ||
verses.en: In order to length of life, to great joy, we, taking no harm, all the time capable (dakṣ), bear the jan̄giḍá, the víṣkandha-spoiling amulet.

verses.sa:
जङ्गिडो जम्भाद्विशराद्विष्कन्धादभिशोचनात्।
मणिः सहस्रवीर्यः परि णः पातु विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
jangido jambhadvisharadvishkandhadabhishochanat|
manih sahasraviryah pari nah patu vishvatah ||
verses.en: From jambá, from viçará, from víṣkandha, from scorching (abhiçócana), let the jan̄giḍá, the amulet of thousand-fold valiance (-vīryà), protect us about on every side.

verses.sa:
अयं विष्कन्धं सहतेऽयं बाधते अत्त्रिणः ।
अयं नो विश्वभेषजो जङ्गिडः पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vishkandham sahate'yam badhate attrinah |
ayam no vishvabheshajo jangidah patvamhasah ||
verses.en: This one overpowers the víṣkandha; this drives off the devourers; let this jan̄giḍá, possessing all remedies, protect us from distress.

verses.sa:
देवैर्दत्तेन मणिना जङ्गिडेन मयोभुवा ।
विष्कन्धं सर्वा रक्षांसि व्यायामे सहामहे ॥
verses.rom:
devairdattena manina jangidena mayobhuva |
vishkandham sarva rakshamsi vyayame sahamahe ||
verses.en: With the amulet given by the gods, the kindly jan̄giḍá, we overpower in the struggle (vyāyāmá) the víṣkandha [and] all demons.

verses.sa:
शणश्च मा जङ्गिडश्च विष्कन्धादभि रक्षताम् ।
अरण्यादन्य आभृतः कृष्या अन्यो रसेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
shanashcha ma jangidashcha vishkandhadabhi rakshatam |
aranyadanya abhritah krishya anyo rasebhyah ||
verses.en: Let both the hemp and the jan̄giḍá defend me from the víṣkandha: the one brought from the forest, the other from the juices (rása) of ploughing.

verses.sa:
कृत्यादूषिरयं मणिरथो अरातिदूषिः ।
अथो सहस्वान् जङ्गिडः प्र ण आयुंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
krityadushirayam maniratho aratidushih |
atho sahasvan jangidah pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: Witchcraft-spoiling is this amulet, likewise niggard-spoiling; likewise shall the pov/eriul jan̄giḍá prolong our life-times.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिभ्याम् ।
पिबा सुतस्य मतेरिह मधोश्चकानश्चारुर्मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
indra jushasva pra vaha yahi shura haribhyam |
piba sutasya materiha madhoshchakanashcharurmadaya ||
verses.en: O Indra, enjoy thou—drive on;—come, O hero—with thy two bays;—drink of the pressed [soma]—intoxicated here—loving the sweet [draught], fair one, unto intoxication.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जठरं नव्यो न पृणस्व मधोर्दिवो न ।
अस्य सुतस्य स्वर्णोप त्वा मदाः सुवाचो अगुः ॥
verses.rom:
indra jatharam navyo na prinasva madhordivo na |
asya sutasya svarnopa tva madah suvacho aguh ||
verses.en: O Indra, [thy] belly—like one to be praised—fill thou with the sweet [draught]—like the heavens—with this soma—like the sky (svàr)—; unto thee have gone the well-voiced intoxications.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्तुराषाण्मित्रो वृत्रं यो जघान यतीर्न ।
बिभेद वलं भृगुर्न ससहे शत्रून् मदे सोमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
indrasturashanmitro vritram yo jaghana yatirna |
bibheda valam bhrigurna sasahe shatrun made somasya ||
verses.en: Indra, a swiftly-overcoming friend, who slew Vritra—like moving [streams]—, [who] split Vala—like Bhṛgu—, who overpowered his foes in the intoxication of soma.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्तु सुतास इन्द्र पृणस्व कुक्षी विड्ढि शक्र धियेह्या नः ।
श्रुधी हवं गिरो मे जुषस्वेन्द्र स्वयुग्भिर्मत्स्वेह महे रणाय ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vishantu sutasa indra prinasva kukshi viddhi shakra dhiyehya nah |
shrudhi havam giro me jushasvendra svayugbhirmatsveha mahe ranaya ||
verses.en: Let the pressed [somas] enter thee, O Indra; fill thy (two) paunches; help, O mighty one! for our prayer (dhī́) come to us; hear [my] call, enjoy my songs; hither, O Indra, with self-harnessed [steeds]; revel here unto great joy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु प्र वोचं वीर्याणि यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री ।
अहन्न् अहिमनु अपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत्पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya nu pra vocham viryani yani chakara prathamani vajri |
ahann ahimanu apastatarda pra vakshana abhinatparvatanam ||
verses.en: Now will I proclaim the heroisms of Indra, which first he of the thunderbolt (vajrín) did; he slew the dragon (áhi); he penetrated to the waters; he split forth the bellies (vakṣáṇā) of the mountains.

verses.sa:
अहन्न् अहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं त्वष्टास्मै वज्रं स्वर्यं ततक्ष ।
वाश्रा इव धेनवः स्यन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः ॥
verses.rom:
ahann ahim parvate shishriyanam tvashtasmai vajram svaryam tataksha |
vashra iva dhenavah syandamana anjah samudramava jagmurapah ||
verses.en: He slew the dragon that had resorted (çri) to the mountain; Tvashṭar fashioned for him the whizzing (?) thunderbolt; like lowing kine, flowing (syand), at once the waters went down to the ocean.

verses.sa:
वृषायमाणो अवृणीत सोमं त्रिकद्रुकेषु अपिबत्सुतस्य ।
आ सायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्न् एनं प्रथमजामहीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishayamano avrinita somam trikadrukeshu apibatsutasya |
a sayakam maghavadatta vajramahann enam prathamajamahinam ||
verses.en: Acting like a bull, he chose the soma; he drank of the pressed [draught] in the tríkadrukas; the bounteous one (maghávan) took his missile thunderbolt; he slew that first-born of dragons.

verses.sa:
समास्त्वाग्न ऋतवो वर्धयन्तु संवत्सरा ऋषयो यानि सत्या ।
सं दिव्येन दीदिहि रोचनेन विश्वा आ भाहि प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
samastvagna ritavo vardhayantu samvatsara rishayo yani satya |
sam divyena didihi rochanena vishva a bhahi pradishashchatasrah ||
verses.en: Let the summers (sámā), O Agni, the seasons, increase thee, the years, the seers, what things are true; shine thou with the heavenly bright space (rocaná); illuminate (ā-bhā) all the four directions.

verses.sa:
सं चेध्यस्वाग्ने प्र च वर्धयेममुच्च तिष्ठ महते सौभगाय ।
मा ते रिषन्न् उपसत्तारो अग्ने ब्रह्माणस्ते यशसः सन्तु मान्ये ॥
verses.rom:
sam chedhyasvagne pra cha vardhayemamuchcha tishtha mahate saubhagaya |
ma te rishann upasattaro agne brahmanaste yashasah santu manye ||
verses.en: Both do thou become kindled, Agni, and do thou increase this man, and arise unto great good fortune; let not thine attendants (upasattár) be harmed, O Agni; be thy worshipers (brahmán) glorious, not others.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने वृणते ब्राह्मणा इमे शिवो अग्ने संवरणे भवा नः ।
सपत्नहाग्ने अभिमातिजिद्भव स्वे गये जागृह्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vrinate brahmana ime shivo agne samvarane bhava nah |
sapatnahagne abhimatijidbhava sve gaye jagrihyaprayuchchhan ||
verses.en: Thee, O Agni, do these Brahmans choose; be propitious to us, O Agni, in the [sacrificial] enclosure (? saṁváraṇa); rival-slayer, Agni, conqueror of hostile plotters, be thou; watch unremitting over thine own household.

verses.sa:
क्षत्रेणाग्ने स्वेन सं रभस्व मित्रेणाग्ने मित्रधा यतस्व ।
सजातानां मध्यमेष्ठा राज्ञामग्ने विहव्यो दीदिहीह ॥
verses.rom:
kshatrenagne svena sam rabhasva mitrenagne mitradha yatasva |
sajatanam madhyameshtha rajnamagne vihavyo didihiha ||
verses.en: Take hold of thine own dominion (kṣatrá), Agni; with [thy] friend, Agni, strive (yat) in friendly wise; [as one] of midmost station among [his] fellows (sajātá), [as one] to be severally invoked of kings, Agni, shine thou here.

verses.sa:
अति निहो अति सृधोऽत्यचित्तीरति द्विषः ।
विश्वा ह्यग्ने दुरिता तर त्वमथास्मभ्यं सहवीरं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
ati niho ati sridho'tyachittirati dvishah |
vishva hyagne durita tara tvamathasmabhyam sahaviram rayim dah ||
verses.en: Over enviers, over delinquents, over the thoughtless, over haters,—verily all difficult things, O Agni, do thou cross; then mayest thou give us wealth accompanied with heroes.

verses.sa:
अघद्विष्टा देवजाता वीरुच्छपथयोपनी ।
आपो मलमिव प्राणैक्षीत्सर्वान् मच्छपथामधि ॥
verses.rom:
aghadvishta devajata viruchchhapathayopani |
apo malamiva pranaikshitsarvan machchhapathamadhi ||
verses.en: Hated by mischief, god-born, the curse-effacing plant hath washed away from me all curses, as waters do filth.

verses.sa:
यश्च सापत्नः शपथो जाम्याः शपथश्च यः ।
ब्रह्मा यन् मन्युतः शपात्सर्वं तन् नो अधस्पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yashcha sapatnah shapatho jamyah shapathashcha yah |
brahma yan manyutah shapatsarvam tan no adhaspadam ||
verses.en: Both the curse that is a rival's, and the curse that is a sister's, what a priest (? brahmán) from fury may curse—all that [be] underneath our feet.

verses.sa:
दिवो मूलमवततं पृथिव्या अध्युत्ततम् ।
तेन सहस्रकाण्डेन परि णः पाहि विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
divo mulamavatatam prithivya adhyuttatam |
tena sahasrakandena pari nah pahi vishvatah ||
verses.en: From the sky [is] the root stretched down, from off the earth stretched up; with this, thousand-jointed (-kā́ṇḍa), do thou protect us about on all sides.

verses.sa:
परि मां परि मे प्रजां परि णः पाहि यद्धनम् ।
अरातिर्नो मा तारीन् मा नस्तारिशुरभिमातयः ॥
verses.rom:
pari mam pari me prajam pari nah pahi yaddhanam |
aratirno ma tarin ma nastarishurabhimatayah ||
verses.en: Protect me about, my progeny, [and] what riches are ours; let not the niggard get the better (tṛ) of us; let not hostile plotters get the better of us.

verses.sa:
शप्तारमेतु शपथो यः सुहार्त्तेन नः सह ।
चक्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हार्दः पृष्टीरपि शृणीमसि ॥
verses.rom:
shaptarametu shapatho yah suharttena nah saha |
chakshurmantrasya durhardah prishtirapi shrinimasi ||
verses.en: Let the curse go to the curser; our [part] is along with him that is friendly (suhā́rd); of the eye-conjurer (-mántra), the unfriendly, we crush in the ribs (pṛṣṭí).

verses.sa:
उदगातां भगवती विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
वि क्षेत्रियस्य मुञ्चतामधमं पाशमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
udagatam bhagavati vichritau nama tarake |
vi kshetriyasya munchatamadhamam pashamuttamam ||
verses.en: Arisen are the (two) blessed stars called the Unfasteners (vicṛ́t); let them unfasten (vi-muc) of the kṣetriyá the lowest, the highest fetter.

verses.sa:
अपेयं रात्र्युच्छत्वपोच्छन्त्वभिकृत्वरीः ।
वीरुत्क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
apeyam ratryuchchhatvapochchhantvabhikritvarih |
virutkshetriyanashanyapa kshetriyamuchchhatu ||
verses.en: Let this night fade away (apa-vas); let the bewitchers (f., abhikṛ́tvan) fade away; let the kṣetriyá-effacing (-nā́çana) plant fade the kṣetriyá away.

verses.sa:
बभ्रोरर्जुनकाण्डस्य यवस्य ते पलाल्या तिलस्य तिलपिञ्ज्या ।
वीरुत्क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
babhrorarjunakandasya yavasya te palalya tilasya tilapinjya |
virutkshetriyanashanyapa kshetriyamuchchhatu ||
verses.en: With the straw of the brown, whitish-jointed barley for thee, with the sesame-stalk (? -piñjī) of sesame, let the kṣetriyá-effacing etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते लाङ्गलेभ्यो नम ईषायुगेभ्यः ।
वीरुत्क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
namaste langalebhyo nama ishayugebhyah |
virutkshetriyanashanyapa kshetriyamuchchhatu ||
verses.en: Homage to thy ploughs (lān̄gala), homage to thy poles-and-yokes: let the kṣetriyá-effacing etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नमः सनिस्रसाक्षेभ्यो नमः संदेश्येभ्यः ।
नमः क्षेत्रस्य पतये वीरुत्क्षेत्रियनाशन्यप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
namah sanisrasakshebhyo namah samdeshyebhyah |
namah kshetrasya pataye virutkshetriyanashanyapa kshetriyamuchchhatu ||
verses.en: Homage to them of constantly falling eyes, homage to them of the same region (? saṁdeçyà), homage to the lord of the field: let the kṣetriyá-effacing etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दशवृक्ष मुञ्चेमं रक्षसो ग्राह्या अधि यैनं जग्राह पर्वसु ।
अथो एनं वनस्पते जीवानां लोकमुन् नय ॥
verses.rom:
dashavriksha munchemam rakshaso grahya adhi yainam jagraha parvasu |
atho enam vanaspate jivanam lokamun naya ||
verses.en: O thou of ten trees, release this man from the demon, from the seizure (grā́hi) that hath seized him in the joints; then, O forest tree, conduct him up to the world of the living.

verses.sa:
आगादुदगादयं जीवानां व्रातमप्यगात्।
अभूदु पुत्राणां पिता नृणां च भगवत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
agadudagadayam jivanam vratamapyagat|
abhudu putranam pita nrinam cha bhagavattamah ||
verses.en: This man hath come, hath arisen, hath gone unto the troop (vrā́ta) of the living; he hath become of sons the father and of men (nṛ́) the most fortunate.

verses.sa:
अधीतीरध्यगादयमधि जीवपुरा अगान् ।
शतं ह्यस्य भिषजः सहस्रमुत वीरुधः ॥
verses.rom:
adhitiradhyagadayamadhi jivapura agan |
shatam hyasya bhishajah sahasramuta virudhah ||
verses.en: He hath attained (adhi-gā) attainments; he hath attained (adhi-gam) the strongholds (-purā) of the living; for a hundred healers are his, also a thousand plants.

verses.sa:
देवास्ते चीतिमविदन् ब्रह्माण उत वीरुधः ।
चीतिं ते विश्वे देवा अविदन् भूम्यामधि ॥
verses.rom:
devaste chitimavidan brahmana uta virudhah |
chitim te vishve deva avidan bhumyamadhi ||
verses.en: The gods have found thy gathering (? cītí), the priests (brahmán) and the plants; all the gods have found thy gathering upon the earth.

verses.sa:
यश्चकार स निष्करत्स एव सुभिषक्तमः ।
स एव तुभ्यं भेषजानि कृणवद्भिषजा शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
yashchakara sa nishkaratsa eva subhishaktamah |
sa eva tubhyam bheshajani krinavadbhishaja shuchih ||
verses.en: Whoso made, he shall unmake; he verily is best of healers; he himself, clean, shall make for thee remedies, with the healer.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रियात्त्वा निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
kshetriyattva nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: From kṣetriyá, from perdition, from imprecation of sisters (jāmí-), from hatred (drúh) do I release thee, from Varuṇa's fetter; free from guilt (-ā́gas) I make thee by [my] incantation; be heaven-and-earth both propitious to thee.

verses.sa:
शं ते अग्निः सहाद्भिरस्तु शं सोमः सहौषधीभिः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham te agnih sahadbhirastu sham somah sahaushadhibhih |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: Weal to thee be Agni, together with the waters; weal [be] Soma, together with the herbs: so from kṣetriyá, from perdition, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शं ते वातो अन्तरिक्षे वयो धाच्छं ते भवन्तु प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham te vato antarikshe vayo dhachchham te bhavantu pradishashchatasrah |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: Weal to thee may the wind in the atmosphere bestow (dhā) vigor; weal to thee be the four directions: so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इमा या देवीः प्रदिशश्चतस्रो वातपत्नीरभि सूर्यो विचष्टे ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ima ya devih pradishashchatasro vatapatnirabhi suryo vichashte |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: These four heavenly (devá) directions, having the wind as lord, upon which the sun looks out—so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तासु त्वान्तर्जरस्या दधामि प्र यक्ष्म एतु निर्ऋतिः पराचैः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasu tvantarjarasya dadhami pra yakshma etu nirritih parachaih |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: Within them I set thee in old age; let the yákṣma, let perdition go forth far away: so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अमुक्था यक्ष्माद्दुरितादवद्याद्द्रुहः पाशाद्ग्राह्याश्चोदमुक्थाः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
amuktha yakshmadduritadavadyaddruhah pashadgrahyashchodamukthah |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: Thou hast been released from yákṣma, from difficulty (duritá), from reproach (avadyá); from the fetter of hatred and from seizure hast thou been released: so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अहा अरातिमविदः स्योनमप्यभूर्भद्रे सुकृतस्य लोके ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
aha aratimavidah syonamapyabhurbhadre sukritasya loke |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: Thou hast left niggardy, hast found what is pleasant; thou hast come to be in the excellent world of what is well done: so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सूर्यमृतं तमसो ग्राह्या अधि देवा मुञ्चन्तो असृजन् निरेनसः ।
एवाहं त्वां क्षेत्रियान् निर्ऋत्या जामिशंसाद्द्रुहो मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशात्।
अनागसं ब्रह्मणा त्वा कृणोमि शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
suryamritam tamaso grahya adhi deva munchanto asrijan nirenasah |
evaham tvam kshetriyan nirritya jamishamsaddruho munchami varunasya pashat|
anagasam brahmana tva krinomi shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam ||
verses.en: The gods, releasing from the seizure of darkness the sun whom it had befallen, let him loose from sin (énas): so from kṣetriyá, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दूष्या दूषिरसि हेत्या हेतिरसि मेन्या मेनिरसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम ॥
verses.rom:
dushya dushirasi hetya hetirasi menya menirasi |
apnuhi shreyamsamati samam krama ||
verses.en: Spoiler's spoiler (dū́ṣi) art thou; missile's missile (hetí) art thou; weapon's weapon (mení) art thou: attain (āp) the better one, step beyond the equal (samá).

verses.sa:
स्रक्त्योऽसि प्रतिसरोऽसि प्रत्यभिचरणोऽसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम ॥
verses.rom:
sraktyo'si pratisaro'si pratyabhicharano'si |
apnuhi shreyamsamati samam krama ||
verses.en: Sraktyà. art thou; re-entrant (pratisará) art thou; counter-conjuring art thou: attain the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रति तमभि चर योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम ॥
verses.rom:
prati tamabhi chara yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah |
apnuhi shreyamsamati samam krama ||
verses.en: Conjure (abhi-car) against him who hates us, whom we hate: attain the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सूरिरसि वर्चोधा असि तनूपानोऽसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम ॥
verses.rom:
surirasi varchodha asi tanupano'si |
apnuhi shreyamsamati samam krama ||
verses.en: Patron (sūrí) art thou; splendor-bestowing art thou; body-protecting art thou: attain the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शुक्रोऽसि भ्राजोऽसि स्वरसि ज्योतिरसि ।
आप्नुहि श्रेयांसमति समं क्राम ॥
verses.rom:
shukro'si bhrajo'si svarasi jyotirasi |
apnuhi shreyamsamati samam krama ||
verses.en: Bright (çukrá) art thou; shining (bhrājá) art thou; heaven (svàr) art thou; light art thou: attain the etc. etc.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी उर्वन्तरिक्षं क्षेत्रस्य पत्न्युरुगायोऽद्भुतः ।
उतान्तरिक्षमुरु वातगोपं त इह तप्यन्तां मयि तप्यमाने ॥
verses.rom:
dyavaprithivi urvantariksham kshetrasya patnyurugayo'dbhutah |
utantarikshamuru vatagopam ta iha tapyantam mayi tapyamane ||
verses.en: Heaven-and-earth, the wide atmosphere, the mistress of the field, the wonderful wide-going one, and the wide wind-guarded atmosphere—let these be inflamed (tapya-) here while I am inflamed.

verses.sa:
इदं देवाः शृणुत ये यज्ञिया स्थ भरद्वाजो मह्यमुक्थानि शंसति ।
पाशे स बद्धो दुरिते नि युज्यतां यो अस्माकं मन इदं हिनस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
idam devah shrinuta ye yajniya stha bharadvajo mahyamukthani shamsati |
pashe sa baddho durite ni yujyatam yo asmakam mana idam hinasti ||
verses.en: Hear this, O ye gods that are worshipful (yajñíya); Bharadvāja sings (çaṅs) hymns (ukthá) for me; let him, bound in a fetter, be plunged (ni-yuj) in difficulty who injures this our mind.

verses.sa:
इदमिन्द्र शृणुहि सोमप यत्त्वा हृदा शोचता जोहवीमि ।
वृश्चामि तं कुलिशेनेव वृक्षं यो अस्माकं मन इदं हिनस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
idamindra shrinuhi somapa yattva hrida shochata johavimi |
vrishchami tam kulisheneva vriksham yo asmakam mana idam hinasti ||
verses.en: Hear this, O Indra, soma-drinker, as I call loudly to thee with a burning (çuc) heart; I hew (vraçc) him [down], as a tree with an ax, who injures this our mind.

verses.sa:
अशीतिभिस्तिसृभिः सामगेभिरादित्येभिर्वसुभिरङ्गिरोभिः ।
इष्टापूर्तमवतु नः पितॄणामामुं ददे हरसा दैव्येन ॥
verses.rom:
ashitibhistisribhih samagebhiradityebhirvasubhirangirobhih |
ishtapurtamavatu nah pitrinamamum dade harasa daivyena ||
verses.en: With thrice eighty sā́man-singers, with the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Angirases—let what is sacrificed-and-bestowed of the Fathers aid us—I take yon man with seizure (háras) of the gods.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी अनु मा दीधीथां विश्वे देवासो अनु मा रभध्वम् ।
अङ्गिरसः पितरः सोम्यासः पापमार्छत्वपकामस्य कर्ता ॥
verses.rom:
dyavaprithivi anu ma didhitham vishve devaso anu ma rabhadhvam |
angirasah pitarah somyasah papamarchhatvapakamasya karta ||
verses.en: O heaven-and-earth, attend (ā-dīdhī) ye after me; O all ye gods, take ye hold (ā-rabh) after me; O Angirases, Fathers, soma-feasting (somyá), let the doer of abhorrence (apakāmá) meet with (ā-ṛ) evil.

verses.sa:
अतीव यो मरुतो मन्यते नो ब्रह्म वा यो निन्दिषत्क्रियमाणम् ।
तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि सन्तु ब्रह्मद्विषं द्यौरभिसंतपाति ॥
verses.rom:
ativa yo maruto manyate no brahma va yo nindishatkriyamanam |
tapumshi tasmai vrijinani santu brahmadvisham dyaurabhisamtapati ||
verses.en: Whoso, O Maruts, thinks himself above us, or whoso shall revile our incantation (bráhman) that is being performed—for him let his wrongdoings be burnings (tápus); the sky shall concentrate its heat (sam-tap) upon the bráhman-hater.

verses.sa:
सप्त प्राणान् अष्टौ मन्यस्तांस्ते वृश्चामि ब्रह्मणा ।
अया यमस्य सादनमग्निदूतो अरंकृतः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta pranan ashtau manyastamste vrishchami brahmana |
aya yamasya sadanamagniduto aramkritah ||
verses.en: Seven breaths, eight marrows: them I hew [off] for thee with [my] incantation; thou shalt go to Yama's seat, messengered by Agni, made satisfactory.

verses.sa:
आ दधामि ते पदं समिद्धे जातवेदसि ।
अग्निः शरीरं वेवेष्ट्वसुं वागपि गच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
a dadhami te padam samiddhe jatavedasi |
agnih shariram veveshtvasum vagapi gachchhatu ||
verses.en: I set thy track in kindled Jātavedas; let Agni dispose of (? viṣ) the body; let speech go unto breath (? ásu).

verses.sa:
आयुर्दा अग्ने जरसं वृणानो घृतप्रतीको घृतपृष्ठो अग्ने ।
घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रान् अभि रक्षतादिमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayurda agne jarasam vrinano ghritapratiko ghritaprishtho agne |
ghritam pitva madhu charu gavyam piteva putran abhi rakshatadimam ||
verses.en: Giving life-time, O Agni, choosing old age; ghee-fronted, ghee-backed, O Agni—having drunk the sweet pleasant (cā́ru) ghee of the cow, do thou afterward defend (rakṣ) this [boy] as a father his sons.

verses.sa:
परि धत्त धत्त नो वर्चसेमं जरामृत्युं कृणुत दीर्घमायुः ।
बृहस्पतिः प्रायच्छद्वास एतत्सोमाय राज्ञे परिधातवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
pari dhatta dhatta no varchasemam jaramrityum krinuta dirghamayuh |
brihaspatih prayachchhadvasa etatsomaya rajne paridhatava u ||
verses.en: Envelop, put ye him for us with splendor; make ye him one to die of old age; [make] long life; Brihaspati furnished (pra-yam) this garment unto king Soma for enveloping [himself].

verses.sa:
परीदं वासो अधिथाः स्वस्तयेऽभूर्गृष्टीनामभिशस्तिपा उ ।
शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूची रायश्च पोषमुपसंव्ययस्व ॥
verses.rom:
paridam vaso adhithah svastaye'bhurgrishtinamabhishastipa u |
shatam cha jiva sharadah puruchi rayashcha poshamupasamvyayasva ||
verses.en: Thou hast put about thee this garment in order to well-being; thou hast become protector of the people (?) against imprecation; both do thou live a hundred numerous autumns, and do thou gather about thee abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
एह्यश्मानमा तिष्ठाश्मा भवतु ते तनूः ।
कृण्वन्तु विश्वे देवा आयुष्टे शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ehyashmanama tishthashma bhavatu te tanuh |
krinvantu vishve deva ayushte sharadah shatam ||
verses.en: Come, stand on the stone; let thy body become a stone; let all the gods make thy life-time a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते वासः प्रथमवास्यं हरामस्तं त्वा विश्वेऽवन्तु देवाः ।
तं त्वा भ्रातरः सुवृधा वर्धमानमनु जायन्तां बहवः सुजातम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te vasah prathamavasyam haramastam tva vishve'vantu devah |
tam tva bhratarah suvridha vardhamanamanu jayantam bahavah sujatam ||
verses.en: Thee here, of whom we take the garment to be first worn, let all the gods favor; thee here, growing with good growth, let many brothers be born after, [after thee,] as one well born.

verses.sa:
निःसालां धृष्णुं धिषणमेकवाद्यां जिघत्स्वम् ।
सर्वाश्चण्डस्य नप्त्यो नाशयामः सदान्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
nihsalam dhrishnum dhishanamekavadyam jighatsvam |
sarvashchandasya naptyo nashayamah sadanvah ||
verses.en: The expeller, the bold, the container, the one-toned, the voracious—all the daughters (naptī́) of the wrathful one, the sadā́nvās, we make to disappear.

verses.sa:
निर्वो गोष्ठादजामसि निरक्षान् निरुपानशात्।
निर्वो मगुन्द्या दुहितरो गृहेभ्यश्चातयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
nirvo goshthadajamasi nirakshan nirupanashat|
nirvo magundya duhitaro grihebhyashchatayamahe ||
verses.en: Out of the cow-stall we drive you, out of the axle, out of the wagon-body (?); out of the houses we expel you, ye daughters (duhitṛ́) of magundī.

verses.sa:
असौ यो अधराद्गृहस्तत्र सन्त्वराय्यः ।
तत्र सेदिर्न्युच्यतु सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ॥
verses.rom:
asau yo adharadgrihastatra santvarayyah |
tatra sedirnyuchyatu sarvashcha yatudhanyah ||
verses.en: Yon house that is below—there let the hags be; there let debility (sedí) make its home (ni-uc), and all the sorceresses.

verses.sa:
भूतपतिर्निरजत्विन्द्रश्चेतः सदान्वाः ।
गृहस्य बुध्न आसीनास्ता इन्द्रो वज्रेणाधि तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.rom:
bhutapatirnirajatvindrashchetah sadanvah |
grihasya budhna asinasta indro vajrenadhi tishthatu ||
verses.en: Let the lord of beings drive out, also Indra, from here the sadā́nvās, sitting on the bottom of the house; let Indra subdue them with the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
यदि स्थ क्षेत्रियाणां यदि वा पुरुषेषिताः ।
यदि स्थ दस्युभ्यो जाता नश्यतेतः सदान्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi stha kshetriyanam yadi va purusheshitah |
yadi stha dasyubhyo jata nashyatetah sadanvah ||
verses.en: If ye are of the endemic (? kṣetriyá) ones, or if sent by men; if ye are born from the barbarians (dásyu)—disappear from here, O sadā́nvās.

verses.sa:
परि धामान्यासामाशुर्गाष्ठामिवासरम् ।
अजैषं सर्वान् आजीन् वो नश्यतेतः सदान्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
pari dhamanyasamashurgashthamivasaram |
ajaisham sarvan ajin vo nashyatetah sadanvah ||
verses.en: I have gone around the abodes (dhāman) of them as a swift [steed about] a race-course; I have won (ji) all your races (ājí); disappear from here, O sadā́nvās.

verses.sa:
यथा द्यौश्च पृथिवी च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha dyaushcha prithivi cha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both the heaven and the earth do not fear, are not harmed, so, my breath, fear not.

verses.sa:
यथाहश्च रात्री च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yathahashcha ratri cha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both the day and the night do not fear etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यश्च चन्द्रश्च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suryashcha chandrashcha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both the sun and the moon do not fear etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha brahma cha kshatram cha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both sacrament (bráhman) and dominion (kṣatrá) do not fear etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा सत्यं चानृतं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha satyam chanritam cha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both truth and untruth do not fear etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा भूतं च भव्यं च न बिभीतो न रिष्यतः ।
एवा मे प्राण मा बिभेः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha bhutam cha bhavyam cha na bibhito na rishyatah |
eva me prana ma bibheh ||
verses.en: As both what is (bhūtá) and what is to be (bhávya) do not fear etc. etc.

verses.sa: प्राणापानौ मृत्योर्मा पातं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: pranapanau mrityorma patam svaha ||
verses.en: O breath-and-expiration, protect me from death: hail (svā́hā)!

verses.sa: द्यावापृथिवी उपश्रुत्या मा पातं स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dyavaprithivi upashrutya ma patam svaha ||
verses.en: O heaven-and-earth, protect me by listening (úpaçruti): hail!

verses.sa: सूर्य चक्षुषा मा पाहि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: surya chakshusha ma pahi svaha ||
verses.en: O sun, protect me by sight: hail!

verses.sa: अग्ने वैश्वानर विश्वैर्मा देवैः पाहि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: agne vaishvanara vishvairma devaih pahi svaha ||
verses.en: O Agni Vāiçvānara, protect me with all the gods: hail!

verses.sa: विश्वम्भर विश्वेन मा भरसा पाहि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: vishvambhara vishvena ma bharasa pahi svaha ||
verses.en: O all-bearing one, protect me with all bearing (bháras): hail!

verses.sa: ओजोऽस्योजो मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: ojo'syojo me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Force art thou; force mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: सहोऽसि सहो मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: saho'si saho me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Power art thou; power mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: बलमसि बलं दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: balamasi balam dah svaha ||
verses.en: Strength art thou; strength mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: आयुरस्यायुर्मे दाः स्वाह ॥
verses.rom: ayurasyayurme dah svaha ||
verses.en: Life-time art thou; life-time mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: श्रोत्रमसि श्रोत्रं मे दाः स्वाह ॥
verses.rom: shrotramasi shrotram me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Hearing art thou; hearing mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: चक्षुरसि चक्षुर्मे दाः स्वाह ॥
verses.rom: chakshurasi chakshurme dah svaha ||
verses.en: Sight art thou; sight mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: परिपाणमसि परिपाणं मे दाः स्वाह ॥
verses.rom: paripanamasi paripanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Protection (paripā́ṇa) art thou; protection mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: भ्रातृव्यक्षयणमसि भ्रातृव्यचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: bhratrivyakshayanamasi bhratrivyachatanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Adversary-destroying art thou; adversary-expulsion mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: सपत्नक्षयणमसि सपत्नचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: sapatnakshayanamasi sapatnachatanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Rival-destroying art thou; rival-expulsion mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: अरायक्षयणमस्यरायचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: arayakshayanamasyarayachatanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Wizard- (? arā́ya-) destroying art thou; wizard-expulsion mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: पिशाचक्षयणमसि पिशाचचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: pishachakshayanamasi pishachachatanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Piçācá-destroying art thou; piçācá-expulsion mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: सदान्वाक्षयणमसि सदान्वाचातनं मे दाः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: sadanvakshayanamasi sadanvachatanam me dah svaha ||
verses.en: Sadā́nvā-destroy'mg art thou; sadā́nvā-expulsion mayest thou give me: hail!

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: agne yatte tapastena tam prati tapa yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: O Agni! with the heat that is thine, be hot against him who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: agne yatte harastena tam prati hara yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: O Agni! with the rage (háras) that is thine, rage against him who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: agne yatte'rchistena tam pratyarcha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: O Agni! with the gleam (arcís) that is thine, gleam against him who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: agne yatte shochistena tam prati shocha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: O Agni! with the burning (çocís) that is thine, burn against him who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: अग्ने यत्ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: agne yatte tejastena tamatejasam krinu yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||
verses.en: O Agni! with the brilliancy (téjas) that is thine, make him unbrilliant who hates us, whom we hate.

verses.sa: वायो यत्ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: vayo yatte tapastena tam prati tapa yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: वायो यत्ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: vayo yatte harastena tam prati hara yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: वायो यत्तेऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रत्यर्च योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: vayo yatte'rchistena tam pratyarcha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: वायो यत्ते शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोच योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: vayo yatte shochistena tam prati shocha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: वायो यत्ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: vayo yatte tejastena tamatejasam krinu yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

prose.en: 1. O Vāyu! with the heat that is thine etc. etc.

verses.sa: सूर्य यत्ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: surya yatte tapastena tam prati tapa yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.rom: surya yatte harastena tam prati hara yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.rom: surya yatte'rchistena tam pratyarcha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.rom: surya yatte shochistena tam prati shocha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: सूर्य यत्ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: surya yatte tejastena tamatejasam krinu yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

prose.en: 1. O Sūrya! with the heat that is thine etc. etc.

verses.sa: चन्द्र यत्ते तपस्तेन तं प्रति तप योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: chandra yatte tapastena tam prati tapa yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: चन्द्र यत्ते हरस्तेन तं प्रति हर योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: chandra yatte harastena tam prati hara yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.rom: chandra yatte'rchistena tam pratyarcha yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: चन्द्र यत्ते तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: chandra yatte tejastena tamatejasam krinu yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

prose.en: 1. O moon! with the heat that is thine etc. etc.

verses.sa: आपो यद्वस्तपस्तेन तं प्रति तपत योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: apo yadvastapastena tam prati tapata yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: आपो यद्वस्हरस्तेन तं प्रति हरत योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: apo yadvasharastena tam prati harata yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: आपो यद्वस्ऽर्चिस्तेन तं प्रति अर्चत योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: apo yadvas'rchistena tam prati archata yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: आपो यद्वस्शोचिस्तेन तं प्रति शोचत योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: apo yadvasshochistena tam prati shochata yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

verses.sa: आपो यद्वस्तेजस्तेन तमतेजसं कृणुत योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मः ॥
verses.rom: apo yadvastejastena tamatejasam krinuta yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmah ||

prose.en: 1. O waters! with the heat that is yours etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शेरभक शेरभ पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
sherabhaka sherabha punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O çerabhaka, çerabha! back again let your familiar demons go; back again your missile, ye kimīdíns! whose ye are, him eat ye; who hath sent you forth, him eat ye; eat your own flesh.

verses.sa:
शेवृधक शेवृध पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
shevridhaka shevridha punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O çevṛdhaka, çévṛdha! back again let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
म्रोकानुम्रोक पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
mrokanumroka punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O mroká, anumroka! back again let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सर्पानुसर्प पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
sarpanusarpa punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O sarpá, anusarpa! back again let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
जूर्णि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
jurni punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O júrṇī! back again let your familiar demons go; back again your missile, ye she-kimīdíns; whose ye are etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उपब्दे पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
upabde punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O upabdi! back again let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अर्जुनि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
arjuni punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O árjunī! back again let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
भरूजि पुनर्वो यन्तु यातवः पुनर्हेतिः किमीदिनः ।
यस्य स्थ तमत्त यो वो प्राहैत्तमत्त स्वा मांसान्यत्त ॥
verses.rom:
bharuji punarvo yantu yatavah punarhetih kimidinah |
yasya stha tamatta yo vo prahaittamatta sva mamsanyatta ||
verses.en: O bharūjī! back again. let your familiar etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवी पृश्निपर्ण्यशं निर्ऋत्या अकः ।
उग्रा हि कण्वजम्भनी तामभक्षि सहस्वतीम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devi prishniparnyasham nirritya akah |
ugra hi kanvajambhani tamabhakshi sahasvatim ||
verses.en: Weal for us, woe (áçam) for Nirṛti ('perdition') hath the divine

verses.sa:
सहमानेयं प्रथमा पृश्निपर्ण्यजायत ।
तयाहं दुर्णाम्नां शिरो वृश्चामि शकुनेरिव ॥
verses.rom:
sahamaneyam prathama prishniparnyajayata |
tayaham durnamnam shiro vrishchami shakuneriva ||
verses.en: This spotted-leaf was first born overpowering; with it do I hew [off] the head of the ill-named ones, as of a bird (çakúni).

verses.sa:
अरायमसृक्पावानं यश्च स्फातिं जिहीर्षति ।
गर्भादं कण्वं नाशय पृश्निपर्णि सहस्व च ॥
verses.rom:
arayamasrikpavanam yashcha sphatim jihirshati |
garbhadam kanvam nashaya prishniparni sahasva cha ||
verses.en: The blood-drinking wizard, and whoso wants to take away fatness, the embryo-eating káṇva do thou make disappear, O spotted-leaf, and overpower.

verses.sa:
गिरिमेनामा वेशय कण्वान् जीवितयोपनान् ।
तांस्त्वं देवि पृश्निपर्ण्यग्निरिवानुदहन्न् इहि ॥
verses.rom:
girimenama veshaya kanvan jivitayopanan |
tamstvam devi prishniparnyagnirivanudahann ihi ||
verses.en: Make them enter the mountain, the life-obstructing (-yopana) káṇvas; do thou, O divine spotted-leaf, go burning after them like fire.

verses.sa:
पराच एनान् प्र णुद कण्वान् जीवितयोपनान् ।
तमांसि यत्र गच्छन्ति तत्क्रव्यादो अजीगमम् ॥
verses.rom:
paracha enan pra nuda kanvan jivitayopanan |
tamamsi yatra gachchhanti tatkravyado ajigamam ||
verses.en: Thrust them forth to a distance, the life-obstructing káṇvas; where the darknesses go, there have I made the flesh-eaters go.

verses.sa:
एह यन्तु पशवो ये परेयुर्वायुर्येषां सहचारं जुजोष ।
त्वष्टा येषां रूपधेयानि वेदास्मिन् तान् गोष्ठे सविता नि यच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
eha yantu pashavo ye pareyurvayuryesham sahacharam jujosha |
tvashta yesham rupadheyani vedasmin tan goshthe savita ni yachchhatu ||
verses.en: Hither let the cattle come that went away, whose companionship (sahacārá) Vāyu (the wind) enjoyed, whose form-givings Tvashṭar knows; in this cow-stall let Savitar make them fast (ni-yam).

verses.sa:
इमं गोष्ठं पशवः सं स्रवन्तु बृहस्पतिरा नयतु प्रजानन् ।
सिनीवाली नयत्वाग्रमेषामाजग्मुषो अनुमते नि यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
imam goshtham pashavah sam sravantu brihaspatira nayatu prajanan |
sinivali nayatvagrameshamajagmusho anumate ni yachchha ||
verses.en: To this cow-stall let cattle flow-together stream together (sam-sru); let Brihaspati, foreknowing, lead them hither; let Sinīvālī lead hither the van (ágra) of them; make them fast when they have come, O Anumati.

verses.sa:
सं सं स्रवन्तु पशवः समश्वाः समु पूरुषाः ।
सं धान्यस्य या स्फातिः संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
sam sam sravantu pashavah samashvah samu purushah |
sam dhanyasya ya sphatih samsravyena havisha juhomi ||
verses.en: Together, together let cattle flow stream, together horses, and together men, together the fatness that is of grain; I offer with an oblation of confluence.

verses.sa:
सं सिञ्चामि गवां क्षीरं समाज्येन बलं रसम् ।
संसिक्ता अस्माकं वीरा ध्रुवा गावो मयि गोपतौ ॥
verses.rom:
sam sinchami gavam kshiram samajyena balam rasam |
samsikta asmakam vira dhruva gavo mayi gopatau ||
verses.en: I pour together the milk (kṣīrá) of kine, together strength, sap, with sacrificial butter; poured together are our heroes; fixed are the kine in me rather, with me [as] kine-lord.

verses.sa:
आ हरामि गवां क्षीरमाहार्षं धान्यं रसम् ।
आहृता अस्माकं वीरा आ पत्नीरिदमस्तकम् ॥
verses.rom:
a harami gavam kshiramaharsham dhanyam rasam |
ahrita asmakam vira a patniridamastakam ||
verses.en: I bring (ā-hṛ) the milk of kine; I have brought the sap of grain; brought are our heroes, our wives, to this home (ástaka).

verses.sa:
नेच्छत्रुः प्राशं जयाति सहमानाभिभूरसि ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
nechchhatruh prasham jayati sahamanabhibhurasi |
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: May [my] foe by no means win (ji) the dispute; overpowering, overcoming art thou; smite the dispute of [my] counter-disputant; make them sapless, O herb.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वान्वविन्दत्सूकरस्त्वाखनन् नसा ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
suparnastvanvavindatsukarastvakhanan nasa |
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: The eagle discovered (anu-vid) thee; the swine dug thee with his snout: smite the dispute etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो ह चक्रे त्वा बाहावसुरेभ्य स्तरीतवे ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
indro ha chakre tva bahavasurebhya staritave |
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: Indra put (kŗ) thee on his arm, in order to lay low (stŗ) the Asuras: smite the dispute etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पाटामिन्द्रो व्याश्नादसुरेभ्य स्तरीतवे ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
patamindro vyashnadasurebhya staritave |
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: Indra consumed (vi-aç) the pāṭá, in order to lay low the Asuras: smite the dispute etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तयाहं शत्रून्त्साक्ष इन्द्रः सालावृकामिव ।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
tayaham shatruntsaksha indrah salavrikamiva |
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: With it will I overpower the foes, as Indra did the sālāvṛkás: smite the dispute etc. etc.

verses.sa:
रुद्र जलाषभेषज नीलशिखण्ड कर्मकृत्।
प्राशं प्रतिप्राशो जह्यरसान् कृण्वोषधे ॥
verses.rom:
rudra jalashabheshaja nilashikhanda karmakrit|
prasham pratiprasho jahyarasan krinvoshadhe ||
verses.en: O Rudra, thou of healing (?) remedies, of dark (nī́la) crests, deed-doer! smite the dispute etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तस्य प्राशं त्वं जहि यो न इन्द्राभिदासति ।
अधि नो ब्रूहि शक्तिभिः प्राशि मामुत्तरं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tasya prasham tvam jahi yo na indrabhidasati |
adhi no bruhi shaktibhih prashi mamuttaram kridhi ||
verses.en: Do thou smite the dispute of him, O Indra, who vexes us; bless us with abilities (çákti); make me superior in the dispute.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमेव जरिमन् वर्धतामयं मेममन्ये मृत्यवो हिंसिषुः शतं ये ।
मातेव पुत्रं प्रमना उपस्थे मित्र एनं मित्रियात्पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyameva jariman vardhatamayam memamanye mrityavo himsishuh shatam ye |
mateva putram pramana upasthe mitra enam mitriyatpatvamhasah ||
verses.en: For just thee, O old age, let this one grow; let not the other deaths, that are a hundred, harm him; as a forethoughtful mother in her lap a son, let Mitra protect him from distress that comes from a friend (mitríya).

verses.sa:
मित्र एनं वरुणो वा रिशादा जरामृत्युं कृणुतां संविदानौ ।
तदग्निर्होता वयुनानि विद्वान् विश्वा देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ॥
verses.rom:
mitra enam varuno va rishada jaramrityum krinutam samvidanau |
tadagnirhota vayunani vidvan vishva devanam janima vivakti ||
verses.en: Let Mitra or helpful (? riçā́dās) Varuṇa in concord make him one that dies of old age; so Agni the offerer (hótar), knowing the ways (vayúna), bespeaks all the births of the gods.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे पशूनां पार्थिवानां ये जाता उत वा ये जनित्राः ।
मेमं प्राणो हासीन् मो अपानो मेमं मित्रा वधिषुर्मो अमित्राः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamishishe pashunam parthivanam ye jata uta va ye janitrah |
memam prano hasin mo apano memam mitra vadhishurmo amitrah ||
verses.en: Thou art master (īç) of earthly cattle, that are born, or also that are to be born; let not breath leave this one, nor expiration; let not friends slay (vadh) this one, nor enemies.

verses.sa:
द्यौष्ट्वा पिता पृथिवी माता जरामृत्युं कृणुतां संविदाने ।
यथा जीवा अदितेरुपस्थे प्राणापानाभ्यां गुपितः शतं हिमाः ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushtva pita prithivi mata jaramrityum krinutam samvidane |
yatha jiva aditerupasthe pranapanabhyam gupitah shatam himah ||
verses.en: Let father heaven, let mother earth, in concord, make thee one that dies of old age; that thou mayest live in the lap of Aditi, guarded by breath and expiration, a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
इममग्ने आयुषे वर्चसे नय प्रियं रेतो वरुण मित्र राजन् ।
मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर्यथासत् ॥
verses.rom:
imamagne ayushe varchase naya priyam reto varuna mitra rajan |
matevasma adite sharma yachchha vishve deva jaradashtiryathasat ||
verses.en: This one, O Agni, do thou lead for life-time, for splendor, to dear seed, O Varuṇa, Mitra, king! like a mother, O Aditi, yield (yam) him refuge; O all ye gods, that he be one reaching old age.

verses.sa:
पार्थिवस्य रसे देवा भगस्य तन्वो बले ।
आयुष्यमस्मा अग्निः सूर्यो वर्च आ धाद्बृहस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
parthivasya rase deva bhagasya tanvo bale |
ayushyamasma agnih suryo varcha a dhadbrihaspatih ||
verses.en: In the sap of what is earthly, O gods, in the strength of Bhaga's self (tanū́)—length of life to this man may Agni, Sūrya—splendor may Brihaspati impart.

verses.sa:
आयुरस्मै धेहि जातवेदः प्रजां त्वष्टरधिनिधेहि अस्मै ।
रायस्पोषं सवितरा सुवास्मै शतं जीवाति शरदस्तवायम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayurasmai dhehi jatavedah prajam tvashtaradhinidhehi asmai |
rayasposham savitara suvasmai shatam jivati sharadastavayam ||
verses.en: Length of life to him assign thou, O Jātavedas; progeny, O Tvashṭar, do thou bestow on him; abundance of wealth, O Savitar ('impeller'), do thou impel to him; may he live a hundred autumns of thee.

verses.sa:
आशीर्ण ऊर्जमुत सौप्रजास्त्वं दक्षं धत्तं द्रविणं सचेतसौ ।
जयं क्षेत्राणि सहसायमिन्द्र कृण्वानो अन्यान् अधरान्त्सपत्नान् ॥
verses.rom:
ashirna urjamuta sauprajastvam daksham dhattam dravinam sachetasau |
jayam kshetrani sahasayamindra krinvano anyan adharantsapatnan ||
verses.en: Our blessing [assign him] refreshment, possession of excellent progeny; do ye (two), accordant, assign [him] dexterity, property (dráviṇa); [let] this man [be] conquering fields with power, O Indra, putting (kṛ) other rivals beneath him.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण दत्तो वरुणेन शिष्टो मरुद्भिरुग्रः प्रहितो नो आगन् ।
एष वां द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे मा क्षुधन् मा तृषत् ॥
verses.rom:
indrena datto varunena shishto marudbhirugrah prahito no agan |
esha vam dyavaprithivi upasthe ma kshudhan ma trishat ||
verses.en: Given by Indra, instructed by Varuṇa, sent forth by the Maruts, hath the formidable one come to us; let this man, in your lap, O heaven-and-earth, not hunger, not thirst.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जमस्मा ऊर्जस्वती धत्तं पयो अस्मै पयस्वती धत्तम् ।
ऊर्जमस्मै द्यावपृथिवी अधातां विश्वे देवा मरुत ऊर्जमापः ॥
verses.rom:
urjamasma urjasvati dhattam payo asmai payasvati dhattam |
urjamasmai dyavaprithivi adhatam vishve deva maruta urjamapah ||
verses.en: Assign refreshment to him, ye (two) that are rich in refreshment; assign milk to him, ye rich in milk; refreshment have heaven-and-earth assigned to him, [have] all the gods, the Maruts, refreshment [have] the waters.

verses.sa:
शिवाभिष्टे हृदयं तर्पयाम्यनमीवो मोदिषीष्ठाः सुवर्चाः ।
सवासिनौ पिबतां मन्थमेतमश्विनो रूपं परिधाय मायाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shivabhishte hridayam tarpayamyanamivo modishishthah suvarchah |
savasinau pibatam manthametamashvino rupam paridhaya mayam ||
verses.en: With propitious things (f.) I gratify thy heart; mayest thou enjoy thyself (mud) free from disease, very splendid; let the two that dwell together (? savāsín) drink this stir-about (manthá), putting on [as] magic the form of the (two) Açvins.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एतां ससृजे विद्धो अग्र ऊर्जां स्वधामजरां सा त एषा ।
तया त्वं जीव शरदः सुवर्चा मा त आ सुस्रोद्भिषजस्ते अक्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
indra etam sasrije viddho agra urjam svadhamajaram sa ta esha |
taya tvam jiva sharadah suvarcha ma ta a susrodbhishajaste akran ||
verses.en: Indra in the beginning, being pierced, created this refreshment, [this] unaging svadhā́; it is thine here; by it live thou for autumns, very splendid; be there no flux of thee; the healers have made [it] for thee.

verses.sa:
यथेदं भूम्या अधि तृणं वातो मथायति ।
एवा मथ्नामि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन् नापगा असः ॥
verses.rom:
yathedam bhumya adhi trinam vato mathayati |
eva mathnami te mano yatha mam kaminyaso yatha man napaga asah ||
verses.en: As the wind here shakes the grass off the earth, so do I shake thy mind, that thou mayest be one loving me, that thou mayest be one not going away from me.

verses.sa:
सं चेन् नयाथो अश्विना कामिना सं च वक्षथः ।
सं वां भगासो अग्मत सं चित्तानि समु व्रता ॥
verses.rom:
sam chen nayatho ashvina kamina sam cha vakshathah |
sam vam bhagaso agmata sam chittani samu vrata ||
verses.en: May ye, O Açvins, both lead together and bring [her] together with him who loves her. The fortunes (bhága) of you (two) have come together, together [your] intents, together [your] courses (vratá).

verses.sa:
यत्सुपर्णा विवक्षवो अनमीवा विवक्षवः ।
तत्र मे गच्छताद्धवं शल्य इव कुल्मलं यथा ॥
verses.rom:
yatsuparna vivakshavo anamiva vivakshavah |
tatra me gachchhataddhavam shalya iva kulmalam yatha ||
verses.en: What the eagles [are] wanting to say, the free from disease [are] wanting to say—there let her come to my call, as the tip to the neck of the arrow (kúlmala).

verses.sa:
यदन्तरं तद्बाह्यं यद्बाह्यं तदन्तरम् ।
कन्यानां विश्वरूपाणां मनो गृभायौषधे ॥
verses.rom:
yadantaram tadbahyam yadbahyam tadantaram |
kanyanam vishvarupanam mano gribhayaushadhe ||
verses.en: What [was] within, [be] that without; what [was] without, [be] that within; of the maidens of many forms seize thou the mind, O herb.

verses.sa:
एयमगन् पतिकामा जनिकामोऽहमागमम् ।
अश्वः कनिक्रदद्यथा भगेनाहं सहागमम् ॥
verses.rom:
eyamagan patikama janikamo'hamagamam |
ashvah kanikradadyatha bhagenaham sahagamam ||
verses.en: Hither hath this woman come, desiring a husband; desiring a wife have I come; like a loud-neighing (krand) horse, together with fortune have I come.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य या मही दृषत्क्रिमेर्विश्वस्य तर्हणी ।
तया पिनष्मि सं क्रिमीन् दृषदा खल्वामिव ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya ya mahi drishatkrimervishvasya tarhani |
taya pinashmi sam krimin drishada khalvamiva ||
verses.en: The great mill-stone that is Indra's, bruiser (tárhaṇa) of every worm—with that I mash (piṣ) together the worms, as khálva-grains with a mill-stone.

verses.sa:
दृष्टमदृष्टमतृहमथो कुरूरुमतृहम् ।
अल्गण्डून्त्सर्वान् छलुनान् क्रिमीन् वचसा जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
drishtamadrishtamatrihamatho kururumatriham |
alganduntsarvan chhalunan krimin vachasa jambhayamasi ||
verses.en: The seen, the unseen one have I bruised, also the kurū́ru have I bruised; all the algáṇḍus, the çalúnas, the worms we grind up with our spell (vácas).

verses.sa:
अल्गण्डून् हन्मि महता वधेन दूना अदूना अरसा अभूवन् ।
शिष्टान् अशिष्टान् नि तिरामि वाचा यथा क्रिमीणां नकिरुच्छिषातै ॥
verses.rom:
algandun hanmi mahata vadhena duna aduna arasa abhuvan |
shishtan ashishtan ni tirami vacha yatha kriminam nakiruchchhishatai ||
verses.en: I smite the algáṇḍus with a great deadly weapon; burnt [or] unburnt, they have become sapless; those left [or] not left I draw down by my spell (vā́c), that no one of the worms be left.

verses.sa:
अन्वान्त्र्यं शीर्षण्यमथो पार्ष्टेयं क्रिमीन् ।
अवस्कवं व्यध्वरं क्रिमीन् वचसा जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
anvantryam shirshanyamatho parshteyam krimin |
avaskavam vyadhvaram krimin vachasa jambhayamasi ||
verses.en: The one along the entrails, the one in the head, likewise the worm in the ribs, the avaskavá, the vyadhvará—the worms we grind up with our spell (vácas).

verses.sa:
ये क्रिमयः पर्वतेशु वनेष्वोषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्वन्तः ।
ये अस्माकं तन्वमाविविशुः सर्वं तद्धन्मि जनिम क्रिमीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye krimayah parvateshu vaneshvoshadhishu pashushvapsvantah |
ye asmakam tanvamavivishuh sarvam taddhanmi janima kriminam ||
verses.en: The worms that are in the mountains, in the woods, in the herbs, in the cattle, within the waters, that have entered our selves (tanū́)—that whole generation (jåniman) of worms I smite.

verses.sa:
उद्यन्न् आदित्यः क्रिमीन् हन्तु निम्रोचन् हन्तु रश्मिभिः ।
ये अन्तः क्रिमयो गवि ॥
verses.rom:
udyann adityah krimin hantu nimrochan hantu rashmibhih |
ye antah krimayo gavi ||
verses.en: Let the sun (ādityá), rising, smite the worms; setting, let him smite [them] with his rays—the worms that are within the cow.

verses.sa:
विश्वरूपं चतुरक्षं क्रिमिं सारङ्गमर्जुनम् ।
शृणाम्यस्य पृष्टीरपि वृश्चामि यच्छिरः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvarupam chaturaksham krimim sarangamarjunam |
shrinamyasya prishtirapi vrishchami yachchhirah ||
verses.en: The worm of all forms, the four-eyed, the variegated, the whitish—I crush (çṛ) the ribs of it; I hew at (api-vraçc) what is its head.

verses.sa:
अत्रिवद्वः क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्ववज्जमदग्निवत्।
अगस्त्यस्य ब्रह्मणा सं पिनष्म्यहं क्रिमीन् ॥
verses.rom:
atrivadvah krimayo hanmi kanvavajjamadagnivat|
agastyasya brahmana sam pinashmyaham krimin ||
verses.en: Like Atri I slay you, O worms, like Kaṇva, like Jamadagni; with the incantation of Agastya I mash together the worms.

verses.sa:
हतो राजा क्रिमीणामुतैषां स्थपतिर्हतः ।
हतो हतमाता क्रिमिर्हतभ्राता हतस्वसा ॥
verses.rom:
hato raja kriminamutaisham sthapatirhatah |
hato hatamata krimirhatabhrata hatasvasa ||
verses.en: Slain is the king of the worms, also the chief (sthapáti) of them is slain; slain is the worm, having its mother slain, its brother slain, its sister slain.

verses.sa:
हतासो अस्य वेशसो हतासः परिवेशसः ।
अथो ये क्षुल्लका इव सर्वे ते क्रिमयो हताः ॥
verses.rom:
hataso asya veshaso hatasah pariveshasah |
atho ye kshullaka iva sarve te krimayo hatah ||
verses.en: Slain are its neighbors (? veçás), slain its further neighbors (? páriveças), also those that are petty (kṣullaká), as it were—all those worms are slain.

verses.sa:
प्र ते शृणामि शृङ्गे याभ्यां वितुदायसि ।
भिनद्मि ते कुषुम्भं यस्ते विषधानः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te shrinami shringe yabhyam vitudayasi |
bhinadmi te kushumbham yaste vishadhanah ||
verses.en: I crush up (pra-çṛ) thy (two) horns, with which thou thrustest; I split thy receptacle (?), which is thy poison-holder.

verses.sa:
अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि ।
यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
akshibhyam te nasikabhyam karnabhyam chhubukadadhi |
yakshmam shirshanyam mastishkajjihvaya vi vrihami te ||
verses.en: Forth from thy (two) eyes, (two) nostrils, (two) ears, chin, brain, tongue, I eject (vi-vṛh) for thee the yákṣma of the head.

verses.sa:
ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात्।
यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
grivabhyasta ushnihabhyah kikasabhyo anukyat|
yakshmam doshanyamamsabhyam bahubhyam vi vrihami te ||
verses.en: From thy neck (grīvás), nape (uṣṇíhās), vertebræ (kī́kasā), backbone, (two) shoulders, (two) fore-arms, I eject for thee the yákṣma of the arms.

verses.sa:
हृदयात्ते परि क्लोम्नो हलीक्ष्णात्पार्श्वाभ्याम् ।
यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां प्लीह्नो यक्नस्ते वि वृहामसि ॥
verses.rom:
hridayatte pari klomno halikshnatparshvabhyam |
yakshmam matasnabhyam plihno yaknaste vi vrihamasi ||
verses.en: Forth from thy heart, lung (klomán), hálīkṣṇa, (two) sides, (two) mátasnas, spleen, liver, we eject for thee the yákṣma.

verses.sa:
आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोरुदरादधि ।
यक्ष्मं कुक्षिभ्यां प्लाशेर्नाभ्या वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
antrebhyaste gudabhyo vanishthorudaradadhi |
yakshmam kukshibhyam plashernabhya vi vrihami te ||
verses.en: Forth from thine entrails, guts, rectum, belly, (two) paunches, plāçí, navel, I eject for thee the yákṣma.

verses.sa:
ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्याम् ।
यक्ष्मं भसद्यं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदं भंससो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
urubhyam te ashthivadbhyam parshnibhyam prapadabhyam |
yakshmam bhasadyam shronibhyam bhasadam bhamsaso vi vrihami te ||
verses.en: From thy (two) thighs, knees, heels, front feet, hips, fundament (? bháṅsas), I eject for thee the yákṣma of the rump.

verses.sa:
अस्थिभ्यस्ते मज्जभ्यः स्नावभ्यो धमनिभ्यः ।
यक्ष्मं पाणिभ्यामङ्गुलिभ्यो नखेभ्यो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
asthibhyaste majjabhyah snavabhyo dhamanibhyah |
yakshmam panibhyamangulibhyo nakhebhyo vi vrihami te ||
verses.en: From thy bones, marrows, sinews, vessels, (two) hands, fingers, nails, I eject for thee the yákṣma.

verses.sa:
अङ्गेअङ्गे लोम्निलोम्नि यस्ते पर्वणिपर्वणि ।
यक्ष्मं त्वचस्यं ते वयं कश्यपस्य वीबर्हेण विष्वञ्चं वि वृहामसि ॥
verses.rom:
angeange lomnilomni yaste parvaniparvani |
yakshmam tvachasyam te vayam kashyapasya vibarhena vishvancham vi vrihamasi ||
verses.en: What [yákṣma is] in thine every limb, every hair, every joint—the yákṣma of thy skin do we, with Kaçyapa's ejector (vībarhá) eject away (víṣvañc).

verses.sa:
य ईशे पशुपतिः पशूनां चतुष्पदामुत यो द्विपदाम् ।
निष्क्रीतः स यज्ञियं भागमेतु रायस्पोषा यजमानं सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ishe pashupatih pashunam chatushpadamuta yo dvipadam |
nishkritah sa yajniyam bhagametu rayasposha yajamanam sachantam ||
verses.en: The lord of cattle, who rules over (īç) the cattle, the four-footed, and who also over the two-footed—let him, bought off, go to [his] sacrificial portion; let abundances of wealth attach themselves to (sac) the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
प्रमुञ्चन्तो भुवनस्य रेतो गातुं धत्त यजमानाय देवाः ।
उपाकृतं शशमानं यदस्थात्प्रियं देवानामप्येतु पाथः ॥
verses.rom:
pramunchanto bhuvanasya reto gatum dhatta yajamanaya devah |
upakritam shashamanam yadasthatpriyam devanamapyetu pathah ||
verses.en: Do ye, releasing (pra-muc) the seed of being, assign progress (gātú) to the sacrificer, O gods; what hath stood brought hither (upákṛta), strenuous (çaçamāná), let it go upon the dear path of the gods.

verses.sa:
ये बध्यमानमनु दीध्याना अन्वैक्षन्त मनसा चक्षुषा च ।
अग्निष्टान् अग्रे प्र मुमोक्तु देवो विश्वकर्मा प्रजया संरराणः ॥
verses.rom:
ye badhyamanamanu didhyana anvaikshanta manasa chakshusha cha |
agnishtan agre pra mumoktu devo vishvakarma prajaya samraranah ||
verses.en: They who, giving attention to (anu-dhī) the one being bound, looked after [him] with mind and with eye—let the divine Agni at first (ágre) release them, he the all-working, in unison with (saṁ-rā) progeny.

verses.sa:
ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपा विरूपाः सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः ।
वायुष्टान् अग्रे प्र मुमोक्तु देवः प्रजापतिः प्रजया संरराणः ॥
verses.rom:
ye gramyah pashavo vishvarupa virupah santo bahudhaikarupah |
vayushtan agre pra mumoktu devah prajapatih prajaya samraranah ||
verses.en: The cattle that are of the village, all-formed, being of various forms, manifoldly of one form—let the divine Vāyu at first release them, Prajāpati, in unison with progeny.

verses.sa:
प्रजानन्तः प्रति गृह्णन्तु पूर्वे प्राणमङ्गेभ्यः पर्याचरन्तम् ।
दिवं गच्छ प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः स्वर्गं याहि पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
verses.rom:
prajanantah prati grihnantu purve pranamangebhyah paryacharantam |
divam gachchha prati tishtha shariraih svargam yahi pathibhirdevayanaih ||
verses.en: Foreknowing, let them first (pū́rva) receive the breath (prāṇá) coming to [them] forth from the limbs. Go to heaven; stand firm with thy bodies; go to paradise (svargá) by god-traveled roads.

verses.sa:
ये भक्षयन्तो न वसून्यानृधुर्यान् अग्नयो अन्वतप्यन्त धिष्ण्याः ।
या तेषामवया दुरिष्टिः स्विष्टिं नस्तां कृणवद्विश्वकर्मा ॥
verses.rom:
ye bhakshayanto na vasunyanridhuryan agnayo anvatapyanta dhishnyah |
ya teshamavaya durishtih svishtim nastam krinavadvishvakarma ||
verses.en: They who, partaking [of soma] (bhakṣ), did not prosper (ṛdh) in good things, whom the fires of the sacrificial hearth were distressed about (anu-tapya-)—what was the expiation (avayá) of their ill-sacrifice, may Viçvakarman ('the all-worker') make that for us a good sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यज्ञपतिमृषयः एनसाहुर्निर्भक्तं प्रजा अनुतप्यमानम् ।
मथव्यान्त्स्तोकान् अप यान् रराध सं नष्टेभिः सृजतु विश्वकर्मा ॥
verses.rom:
yajnapatimrishayah enasahurnirbhaktam praja anutapyamanam |
mathavyantstokan apa yan raradha sam nashtebhih srijatu vishvakarma ||
verses.en: The seers declare the master (-páti) of the sacrifice by reason of sin disportioned, distressed about [his] offspring. What honeyed drops he offended in (? apa-rādh), with them let Viçvakarman unite (sam-sṛj) us.

verses.sa:
अदान्यान्त्सोमपान् मन्यमानो यज्ञस्य विद्वान्त्समये न धीरः ।
यदेनश्चकृवान् बद्ध एष तं विश्वकर्मन् प्र मुञ्चा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
adanyantsomapan manyamano yajnasya vidvantsamaye na dhirah |
yadenashchakrivan baddha esha tam vishvakarman pra muncha svastaye ||
verses.en: Thinking the soma-drinkers to be unworthy of gifts (? adānyá), [though] knowing of the sacrifice, [he is] not wise (dhī́ra) in the conjuncture (samayá); in that this man is bound having committed a sin, do thou, O Viçvakarman, release him for his well-being.

verses.sa:
घोरा ऋषयो नमो अस्त्वेभ्यश्चक्षुर्यदेषां मनसश्च सत्यम् ।
बृहस्पतये महिष द्युमन्न् नमो विश्वकर्मन् नमस्ते पाह्यस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
ghora rishayo namo astvebhyashchakshuryadesham manasashcha satyam |
brihaspataye mahisha dyumann namo vishvakarman namaste pahyasman ||
verses.en: Terrible [are] the seers; homage be to them! what sight [is] theirs, and the actuality (satyá) of their mind. For Brihaspati, O bull (mahiṣá), [be] bright (dyumánt) homage; O Viçvakarman, homage to thee! protect thou us.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य चक्षुः प्रभृतिर्मुखं च वाचा श्रोत्रेण मनसा जुहोमि ।
इमं यज्ञं विततं विश्वकर्मणा देवा यन्तु सुमनस्यमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya chakshuh prabhritirmukham cha vacha shrotrena manasa juhomi |
imam yajnam vitatam vishvakarmana deva yantu sumanasyamanah ||
verses.en: The sacrifice's eye, commencement, and face: with voice, hearing, mind I make oblation. To this sacrifice, extended by Viçvakarman, let the gods come, well-willing.

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने सुमतिं संभलो गमेदिमां कुमारीं सह नो भगेन ।
जुष्टा वरेषु समनेषु वल्गुरोषं पत्या सौभगमस्तु अस्यै ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne sumatim sambhalo gamedimam kumarim saha no bhagena |
jushta vareshu samaneshu valgurosham patya saubhagamastu asyai ||
verses.en: Unto our favor, O Agni, may a wooer come, to this girl, along with our fortune (bhága). Enjoyable (juṣṭá) [is she] to suitors (vará), agreeable at festivals (sámana); be there quickly good-fortune for her with a husband.

verses.sa:
सोमजुष्टं ब्रह्मजुष्टमर्यम्णा संभृतं भगम् ।
धातुर्देवस्य सत्येन कृणोमि पतिवेदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
somajushtam brahmajushtamaryamna sambhritam bhagam |
dhaturdevasya satyena krinomi pativedanam ||
verses.en: Fortune enjoyed by Soma, enjoyed by Brahman, brought together by Aryaman; with the truth of divine Dhātar, the husband-finder I perform (kṛ).

verses.sa:
इयमग्ने नारी पतिं विदेष्ट सोमो हि राजा सुभगां कृणोति ।
सुवाना पुत्रान् महिषी भवाति गत्वा पतिं सुभगा वि राजतु ॥
verses.rom:
iyamagne nari patim videshta somo hi raja subhagam krinoti |
suvana putran mahishi bhavati gatva patim subhaga vi rajatu ||
verses.en: May this woman, O Agni, find a husband; for king Soma maketh her of good-fortune; giving birth to sons, she shall become chief consort (máhiṣī); having gone to a husband, let her, having good-fortune, bear rule (vi-rāj).

verses.sa:
यथाखरो मघवंश्चारुरेष प्रियो मृगाणां सुषदा बभूव ।
एवा भगस्य जुष्टेयमस्तु नारी संप्रिया पत्याविराधयन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
yathakharo maghavamshcharuresha priyo mriganam sushada babhuva |
eva bhagasya jushteyamastu nari sampriya patyaviradhayanti ||
verses.en: As, O bounteous one (maghávan), this pleasant covert hath been dear to the well-settled (suṣád) wild beasts, so let this woman be enjoyed of Bhaga, mutually dear, not disagreeing with her husband.

verses.sa:
भगस्य नावमा रोह पूर्णामनुपदस्वतीम् ।
तयोपप्रतारय यो वरः प्रतिकाम्यः ॥
verses.rom:
bhagasya navama roha purnamanupadasvatim |
tayopaprataraya yo varah pratikamyah ||
verses.en: Ascend thou the boat of Bhaga, full, unfailing; with that cause to cross over hither a suitor who is according to thy wish.

verses.sa:
आ क्रन्दय धनपते वरमामनसं कृणु ।
सर्वं प्रदक्षिणं कृणु यो वरः प्रतिकाम्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a krandaya dhanapate varamamanasam krinu |
sarvam pradakshinam krinu yo varah pratikamyah ||
verses.en: Shout to [him], O lord of riches; make a suitor hither-minded; turn the right side to every one who is a suitor according to thy wish.

verses.sa:
इदं हिरण्यं गुल्गुल्वयमौक्षो अथो भगः ।
एते पतिभ्यस्त्वामदुः प्रतिकामाय वेत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
idam hiranyam gulgulvayamauksho atho bhagah |
ete patibhyastvamaduh pratikamaya vettave ||
verses.en: Here [is] gold, bdellium; here [is] āukṣá, likewise fortune; these have given thee unto husbands, in order to find one according to thy wish.

verses.sa:
आ ते नयतु सविता नयतु पतिर्यः प्रतिकाम्यः ।
त्वमस्यै धेह्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
a te nayatu savita nayatu patiryah pratikamyah |
tvamasyai dhehyoshadhe ||
verses.en: Hither let Savitar conduct for thee, conduct a husband that is according to thy wish; do thou assign [him] to her, O herb.
